description: This file contains functions and types for resolving Discord channels from various input formats, including parsing input strings, fetching channel and guild data via API calls, and handling different resolution scenarios.

classes.name: DiscordChannelSummary
classes.description: Represents a summary of a Discord channel with basic properties like id, name, guildId, type, and archived status.

classes.name: DiscordChannelPayload
classes.description: Represents the payload received from Discord API for a channel, including optional thread metadata.

classes.name: DiscordChannelResolution
classes.description: Represents the result of resolving a Discord channel input, including input string, resolution status, associated guild and channel IDs and names, and notes.

methods.name: parseDiscordChannelInput
methods.description: Parses a raw input string to extract potential guild and channel identifiers, handling various formats like mentions, IDs, and slashes.

methods.name: listGuildChannels
methods.description: Fetches the list of channels for a given guild ID using the Discord API.

methods.name: fetchChannel
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific channel by ID from Discord API, handling errors and returning status.

methods.name: preferActiveMatch
methods.description: Selects the most active or relevant channel from a list of candidates based on archived status and thread type.

methods.name: resolveDiscordChannelAllowlist
methods.description: Main exported function that resolves a list of Discord channel input strings into detailed resolution objects, handling various input formats and API lookups.
